notes.title: Updates to v1.1.3
notes.content:
Added new reusable Holy Water item, with a new cooldown system to go along with it
Added new Immunity skill, reduces the length of time the player is poisoned for
Chests appear darker/faded when opened to indicate they're already used
Vito levels up a bit faster
Flame curse circle sound fx no longer plays on the Game Over screen
Greed leech curse updated to be more helpful: +2 treasure / -1 health every 5 seconds -> +3 treasure / -1 health every 6 seconds
Updated red double chest item spawn rates: removed the big epic potion, and reduced boomerang drops from it, added in new holy water item
Rare drop for Elder Gargoyle is the new holy water item
Adjusted boss scaling to have slightly higher health based on player level, and added skill scaling to the boss health in 2p mode
Increased enemy spawn rates a bit as you get deeper

notes.title: Updates to v1.1.2
notes.content:
Skills update now works in 2 player mode! This includes the skills, curses, and fortunes on level up. May still need some tweaking in the future.
Added 2p mode scaling based on the amount of skills both players have to the boss health. More skills you have, more health the bosses will have!
Added a bit more of a delay on the reward screen, so you can't just mash and quickly skip it by accident anymore. 
Buffed tira critical damage some.
Tira's knives can clear out enemy groups a bit better than before.

notes.title: Updates to v1.1.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes related to using controllers on the skills system (works on Steamdeck too!)
Added sound to skill selection
Fixed an icon issue on curses

notes.title: Updates to v1.1.0
notes.content:
New skills system for when the player levels up!
Skills and curses are available as rewards, along with treasure based fortunes.
The pause screen has been updated to reflect your inventory as well as your skills you have attained.
Balancing updates, game is a bit harder and scales better. The bosses too!

notes.title: Updates to v1.0.4
notes.content:
Cooldown speed stat now goes faster when leveling up, meaning the more you level up the faster you can move your special attack. This is now shown on the pause screen too. Initial cooldown speed was reduced a bit to account for this.
More emphasis on leveling up: text popup, slightly louder, and fx moves faster vertically. 
Many 3 enemy variants deal more damage. This includes regular and poison zombies, spider slashes and webs, first form wisps, and both attacks on second form wisps. Then the gorilla zombie earthquake smash in all levels.  
Boss health scales a bit more depending on difficulty. 
Elder Gargoyle attacks all do more damage.
Queen Spider base poison and web do more damage.
Defeating bosses gives much more xp than before.
Pets a bit more rare, more notably on the library floors for the magic blaster wolf spawns.

notes.title: Updates to v1.0.3
notes.content:
Updated pause menu, which shows more information. Player stats, item descriptions, and resized elements.
Ability to drop items during an interaction with the shopkeeper.
Ability to change keyboard controls with the ALT key on the pause menu.
Trail fx on magic projectiles. Vito's magic shots, gargoyle magic, Elder Gargoyle magic, and Spider Queen's poison (along with her head as an item).
UI fix on player two keyboard inputs on the inventory toggle.
Fix on gargoyle enemies being poisoned.
